<reason>CON won the timing clash that decides the motion. PRO allowed targeted monitoring for specific concern but never solved the first-incident problem: its pre-harm signals arrive after the drink, curfew, or concealment. CON answered PRO's audit and end-point pressures with a workable who-not-what filter and an age-based stop at 18, while PRO's dot-only-records and evasion points were blunted by intervene-if-running and seatbelt replies.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON's Rebuttal 1 circularity plus Rebuttal 2 late-signals turn - smell after drink, missed curfew after gone, pattern of lying is concealment that worked - which left PRO relying on teen-initiated pickup that fails for the pressured teen who will not call.</best_rebuttal>
